name: price-list-updater
description: Change a whole price list in one go: raise drinks 5%, add 1 to one supplier, set a single SKU to 12.90, or price everything from cost plus a markup — then round to charm prices like 12.9, 12.99 or 19. Every row shows old price, new price, change and margin; override any single price and it stays when you tweak the rules. Low margins, prices under cost, big jumps and rules that match nothing are flagged. Export the updated sheet with all your original columns (changed prices highlighted, old price in a note) and a before/after CSV. Runs locally; no store login or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 一次改完整张价目表：饮料涨 5%、某个供应商的商品加 1 元、单个 SKU 改成 12.9，或者按进价加成定价，再统一取尾数（12.9、12.99、19 这样）。每行显示原价、新价、涨跌和毛利率；单个价格可以手动改，之后调规则也会保留。会提示毛利率过低、低于进价、涨跌幅过大和没有匹配到商品的规则。导出新价目表（保留原表所有列，改动的价格标色、批注原价）和改价对照 CSV。在本地运行，不用登录店铺，无需 API 密钥。
